Package org.webharvest.definition

Interface ConfigLocationVisitor

  • All Known Implementing Classes:
    IncludeVisitor
    public interface ConfigLocationVisitor
    Represents object implementing Visitor patter. Provides polymorphic handler methods on visitable location objects that implements ConfigLocationVisitor.VisitableLocation.
    Since:
    2.1.0-SNAPSHOT
    Version:
    %I%, %G%
    Author:
    Robert Bala
